Select molecule_chembl_id as compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles as canonical_smiles
Join activities on activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id
Join assays on assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id
Join target_dictionary on target_dictionary.tid = assays.tid
Join molecule_dictionary on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno
Join compound_structures on compound_structures.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Filter target_dictionary.pref_name = 'histone deacetylase 1' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles
Sort by compound_chembl_id
